messages:
Sam: Ran a FlashWeave variant sweep (A100 / H100 / L40S) across seq={32,128,512,2048} bsz={1,4,16,64}. Weird H100 drop at seq=512 bsz=16 — throughput down ~28% vs A100 and tail latency jitter. Artifacts: <https://ci.redwood/bench/3741592653|bench/3741592653> :eyes:
PerfBot: CI artifacts uploaded: perf.csv, flamegraphs/, nvprof logs. Summary attached in perf.csv.
Maya: Can you paste the top-line numbers? Also, did you run with the kernel-selector enabled or forced variants?
Sam: Top-line numbers (tokens/sec):
```
seq  bsz  A100    H100    L40S
32   16   21000   23000   12000
128  16   18000   17000   11000
512  16   15000   10800   9000   <-- H100 drop
2048 16   8000    7600    6500
```
Jin: Any kernel fallback logs? Which kernel did selector pick for H100 at 512x16?
Sam: Kernel-chooser picked `paged_flash_v2` on H100 for 512x16; A100 kept `fused_flash`. nvprof shows suspicious memcpy stalls and high L2 traffic:
```
== NVPROF ==
Memcpy HtoD: 1.2s (spike)
Kernel 'paged_flash_v2': avg 9.1ms (high memcopy overhead)
Kernel 'fused_flash' on A100: avg 6.3ms
```
Katie: Can you force fused_flash on H100 for that config and re-run quickly?
Sam: Forced fused_flash on H100 -> throughput 14500 tkn/s (was 10800). So selector misranked by ~35%. Repro command:
```
docker run --gpus all bench/flashweave:latest --model /models/7b --gpu H100 --seq 512 --bsz 16 --force-kernel fused_flash
```
Maya: Looks like the kernel scoring heuristic underestimates memcpy cost on H100 for mid-long seq with mid bsz. Suggest adding a memcpy_penalty when gpu_type==H100 and seq>256 and 8<=bsz<=32.
Jin: I'll open a tiny PR to adjust selector weights + add a perf test. @PerfBot can you create a regression alert for H100 seq=512 bsz=16 >15%?
PerfBot: Alert created: `H100-flashweave-regress-512x16`. Dashboard: <https://dash.redwood/alerts/3741592653>
Sam: Sweet. I'll run a canary on dedicated infra this afternoon and post results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
